description: **Available Immediately** **Furnished/Unfurnished** **Flexible Lease Term**Sherry FitzGerald Lettings are delighted to present this classic contemporary semi-detached home, completely refurbished and modernised throughout, located in the sought-after Dublin 4 area. The property is in a gated community with 24-hour security.  The property is alarmed and is heated by a modern heat pump system.  The accommodation extends to 184 sqm and comprises of entrance hallway leading into two tv rooms with bright aspect either side of the hallway.  From there you move into an open plan kitchen main living area with a top of the range American style fridge freezer and magnificent island with white marble worktop. The washing machine and drier are in a separate utility room.  Large feature doors open out onto a sun-drenched patio.  The garden is extremely private and not overlooked.  There is also a downstairs toilet.  Upstairs there are four double bedrooms, two of which have balconies and two bathrooms, one en-suite.  The bedrooms have ample built-in wardrobe space. The third floor is another open living space.  Viewing highly recommended of this premium home. **Professionally managed by Sherry FitzGerald Lettings**
